summary: New Pacific Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic report by a Canadian foreign private issuer, equivalent to a quarterly earnings release but furnished rather than filed. The filing contains standard financial disclosures (balance sheet, income statement, comprehensive loss) with no announcement of any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate event. No board recommendations, advisors, or deal mechanics are mentioned.
